title: Chapter 33: Correct Usage of the Missing Person Notice
html:
If Monkey had still possessed full control of his limbs, he might have slapped himself for tempting fate. He silently swore never to make predictions inside a Haunted House again.

Separated from his friends, stranded in a dark corridor, unsure when the costumed pursuer might return, and now confronted by dolls that seemed to appear wherever he looked, Monkey’s composure finally began to crack. “How did it get there? When did it move?”

Questions crowded his thoughts faster than he could answer them. His hands shook around the phone.

“Monkey, where are you? Please hurry! I swear the dolls in this room keep looking at me!” Shi Ling’s frightened voice burst through the speaker.

“I’m trying to find you, but I could use rescuing myself right now.” Monkey stepped back—and felt something brush his shoe. He looked down. The doll that had been farther away now lay beside his foot.

Its dark hair looked startlingly realistic. The worn face was tilted upward, its expression impossible to read.It’s smiling.

Monkey had no idea why that thought came to him. After everything that had happened in the previous ten minutes, he no longer trusted his own nerves.

He tried to move away, but one calf suddenly seized with a painful cramp.Seriously? Now?

Monkey sank to the floor, clutching his leg. Pride forgotten, he shouted, “I quit! Someone get me out of here!”

At that moment, Chen Ge and Xu Wan were escorting another frightened visitor out through a staff passage when they heard Monkey call for help from the third floor. They immediately headed upstairs.

Chen Ge found Monkey sitting on the floor. He signaled Xu Wan to stay back and approached with the house lights raised. “Are you hurt?”

“I quit. Completely. Permanently. Just get me out.”

Chen Ge stopped the scare and gave Monkey a moment to recover before helping him stand.

As he did, he glanced around in confusion.Neither Xiao Wan nor I was anywhere near him. What scared him this badly?

Apart from two rag dolls on the floor, nothing looked unusual. “What happened to you?” Chen Ge asked.

“Those dolls followed me!” Monkey pointed at them accusingly. “You were controlling them somehow, weren’t you? That is completely unfair.”

“The dolls followed you?” Chen Ge paused. He decided this was not the moment to explain that he had not been controlling them. “Let’s get you outside first.”

“Wait. Shi Ling is trapped somewhere on this floor too. She sounded terrified.” Monkey called her again. While he was distracted, Chen Ge picked up the two dolls. They were small, crude handmade toys, closer to children’s craft projects than professional Haunted House props.

These two little things scared a grown university student into giving up?Chen Ge lightly tapped one doll’s cheek. For a strange instant, he had the impression that it resented the indignity but could do nothing about it.Interesting.

Following Shi Ling’s voice through the phone, Chen Ge and Monkey located the room and opened the door from outside.

“It’s all right. We’re getting you out.”

Shi Ling barely seemed to hear him. She was huddled in the corner, trembling. “The dolls keep looking at me. No matter where I move, it feels like their eyes follow me.”

“More dolls?” Chen Ge looked toward the center of the room, where two slightly larger rag dolls lay side by side.

“They were sitting upright before. I swear they were.” Shi Ling’s eyes were wet with fear.

“I believe you. For now, let’s just get you outside.” Chen Ge kept his voice calm, then glanced at the dolls. One had a stitched beard; the other wore a tiny apron.

Those details make them look like the father and mother.He set down the two dolls he had collected from the corridor. Together, the four looked unmistakably like a family.

Four dolls. Four members of the family from Fu An Apartments. Murder by Midnight was built from that case, so are these supposed to represent the actual victims?

The black phone vibrated in his pocket. A new message had appeared.

“Specters’ Favored: Hidden Mission triggered in Murder by Midnight. The lingering spirits still have unfinished business in the mortal world. Help them resolve it, and they may become allies.”

A Hidden Mission? The scenarios unlocked by the black phone have secret objectives too?For Chen Ge, this was a major discovery.Their unfinished business must involve Wang Qi. If he has been caught and will answer for what he did, shouldn’t that already satisfy them?

Chen Ge escorted Shi Ling and Monkey downstairs, but his mind remained on the Hidden Mission. After bringing them out through the staff route, he hurried to the props room and retrieved Wang Qi’s missing-person notice from the wooden box.

This might be connected to what they want.With that thought, he returned alone to the third-floor room where Shi Ling had been trapped.

The moment he crossed the threshold, something looked different.

Three dolls—the parents and older sister—lay where he had left them. The smallest one, however, had somehow ended up near the doorway, face-down as if caught in the middle of an escape attempt. When Chen Ge picked it up, he had the absurd impression that the doll was pretending not to have moved. Instead of frightening him, the behavior was almost endearing.The family’s lingering spirits really may be attached to these dolls.

He closed the door and sat in the middle of the room.

“All right. Maybe we can talk this out.”
